parsed.explanation: Criminalisation is enforced, not dead-letter: the 2023 report records enforcement; presentation-based arrests and a 2023 cross-dressing conviction to civil prison show trans people are actively targeted via decency/immorality provisions, plus documented police sexual coercion (2019) and loitering-law extortion. No gender-marker change, no anti-discrimination law, custody and healthcare discrimination documented, and victims deterred from reporting. This is state-tolerated targeting with failed recourse — tier-2 organised targeting plus a working criminal lever, matching the 0.25 band: recurring police/arrest coercion below the near-automatic campaigns of 0.15, but well above elevated-risk profiles where no targeting exists. Dated capital-policing account and thin trans-specific frequency data temper but do not lift the score.
